owner: Design, Trust and Conversion Teachers + CEO-C Build Factory General Manager
purpose: Make design, trust and conversion rules shared across all public/demo pages and monetization projects.

global_design_rules.rule: First screen must explain what the product does, for whom and why it matters in 10 seconds.
global_design_rules.qa_block: Generic AI slogans without specific outcome are blocked.

global_design_rules.rule: Trust signals must be visible before CTA.
global_design_rules.qa_block: Page cannot sell a paid pilot without proof, scope, limits and handoff path.

global_design_rules.rule: Demo page must show workflow, not just explanation.
global_design_rules.qa_block: Static text-only demo is insufficient when table/rules/workflow proof can be shown.

global_design_rules.rule: Photos are lower priority than page clarity and operational trust for this product family.
global_design_rules.qa_block: Do not delay workflow proof because product photos are inconsistent.

global_design_rules.rule: Every page needs one primary CTA and one next proof action.
global_design_rules.qa_block: Page with no CTA, no next action and no proof path cannot be sell_ready.

project_specific_design_rules.page_goal: Show seller workflow: add part, category, location, price/floor, listing status, order, dead-stock.
Show operating system control: tasks, blockers, QA, revenue, CFO, delivery and learning sync.
Sell one narrow 72h automation outcome, not a generic AI agency.
Show monitored signals with provenance, confidence and action recommendations.
Show brief-to-variants workflow with QA and next-test recommendation.
Stay validation-first: audience, moat, cost and monetization path before production.

done_proof: Every demo/landing page has hero, outcome, trust, proof and CTA.
Generic AI wording is replaced by project-specific workflow language.
CEO Cockpit and Parts Seller OS show learning sync/workflow evidence.
Optional projects remain validation-first unless promoted by gates.
